title: C Programming
description: Master low-level systems programming, pointer mechanics, manual memory management, and data structures in C.
outcomes: Master fundamental to advanced concepts in C Programming.
Build industry-standard applications and capstone projects.
Excel in technical interviews and competitive programming.

modules.title: Introduction to C & Environment Setup
modules.description: History of C, compilation pipeline (preprocessing, compiling, assembling, linking), GCC setup, Hello World, structure of C programs, and comments.

modules.title: Variables, Constants & Data Types
modules.description: Basic data types (int, float, double, char), type qualifiers, variables, constants, type conversion, and sizeof.

modules.title: Operators & Expressions
modules.description: Arithmetic, relational, logical, bitwise, assignment, and conditional operators with precedence rules.

modules.title: Formatted Input and Output (printf & scanf)
modules.description: Standard I/O functions, format specifiers (%d, %f, %c, %s, %p), getchar, putchar, and buffer handling.

modules.title: Control Flow: Conditional Statements
modules.description: if, if-else, nested if, else-if ladder, and switch-case selection statements.

modules.title: Control Flow: Loops & Iteration
modules.description: while, do-while, for loops, nested loops, break, continue, and loop optimization.

modules.title: Functions, Variable Scope & Recursion
modules.description: Function prototypes, definitions, parameters, return types, call by value vs call by reference, variable scope, storage classes, and recursion.

modules.title: Arrays & Multi-Dimensional Matrices
modules.description: 1D arrays, initialization, 2D arrays, matrix multiplication, array passing to functions, and linear search.

modules.title: Strings & Character Manipulation
modules.description: Null-terminated strings, string I/O (gets/fgets, puts), string library functions (strlen, strcpy, strcmp, strcat), and string processing algorithms.

modules.title: Pointers & Pointer Mechanics
modules.description: Pointer concepts, address operator, dereferencing, pointer arithmetic, pointers and arrays, pointers to pointers, and function pointers.

modules.title: Structures, Unions & Typedef
modules.description: User-defined types, struct declaration, struct pointers (arrow operator ->), nested structures, unions, enum, and typedef.

modules.title: File Handling & Low-Level I/O
modules.description: File pointers (FILE *), fopen, fclose, fgetc, fputc, fgets, fputs, fprintf, fscanf, fread, fwrite, and binary file handling.

modules.title: Algorithmic Problem Solving & C Projects
modules.description: Data structure implementations in C, search/sort algorithms, debugging with GDB, and real-world C projects.
